name: Reading a mapped file past its end
component: ground-truth pairing for the sigbus-versus-zero-fill split between the two lanes
required_postconditions: a read past the end of the file returns zero-filled bytes instead of raising a signal

failure_sink.description: the case reports `faulted` when the host raises SIGBUS; an unhandled SIGBUS terminates the process, which is why the sink is process_exit rather than a checked return - nothing in the calling code gets a chance to look

extraction_limitations: Single-claim contract written to pair with a ground-truth case. It asserts exactly one thing so that a whole-contract verdict can be compared against a single observation without ambiguity.
x_groundtruth: POSIX leaves this implementation-defined and one Apple Silicon machine disagrees with itself across its two lanes.
